title: Telegram conversation orchestration
requirements: Add immutable outcome containing ConversationResult and optional callback_query_id; rerun mapper for every accepted update; inject and strictly validate mapper, resolver and conversation.

Direct commands resolve without catalog and call conversation once with the same context. SELECT_SERVICE performs OPEN preflight, reads only ConversationResult.data[catalog], resolves and calls SELECT_SERVICE once; malformed catalog returns TelegramConversationError(CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE). TEXT_INPUT stops on SCREEN_REQUIRED before conversation. Preserve error identity and avoid all transport, persistence, logging, retry and external behavior.
Cover strict dependencies, direct commands, SELECT_SERVICE ordering/context/callback, malformed catalog, zero-call TEXT_INPUT and resolver errors, identity preservation and mutation limits.
acceptance: Focused orchestration tests, Telegram regressions, complete pytest suite and git diff --check pass.
Actual diff stays within allowed paths.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Add the narrow Telegram orchestration boundary over reviewed contracts.
